name: Scholar Feed
description: Search 600,000+ CS/AI research papers with citation graphs, full text, embeddings, and BibTeX. Papers are scraped from ArXiv daily and ranked by novelty and quality with AI. Built for researchers running a literature review where they already work: search, trace citations, pull full text, and export BibTeX in the same session.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Scholar Feed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Scholar Feed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.scholarfeed.org/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Scholar Feed MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scholar Feed lists 25 MCP tools, including search_papers, get_paper, get_citations, fetch_fulltext, find_author, co_author_graph, embed_text, get_field_orientation, get_foundational_lineage, save_paper, unsave_paper, and like_paper.

_published_faq.name: Does Scholar Feed MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scholar Feed requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Scholar Feed is developed by Scholar Feed. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
